test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:

This book is ___ than the one I read last week.
solution:
The correct answer is '**more interesting**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"more interesting"** is the comparative degree of the adjective **"interesting."**
 
• When comparing two things (this book and the one from last week) and using the word **"than,"** the comparative degree is required.
 
• For adjectives with three or more syllables (like in-ter-est-ing), the comparative form is created by adding the word **"more"** before the adjective.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"This book is **more interesting**__ than the one I read last week."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "interesting"** is the positive degree, used for a simple description of one thing without comparison.
 
• **Option 2: "interest"** is a noun or a verb, not an adjective that can fit this comparative structure.
 
• **Option 4: "most interesting"** is the superlative degree, used when comparing one thing to a group of three or more (e.g., "This is the most interesting book in the library").
